name: Ivy League (Council of Ivy Group Presidents)

commissioner.name: Robin Harris
commissioner.note: Executive director since 2009; former attorney/NCAA counsel background.

notes: No athletic scholarships (need-based aid only); academically driven, extremely stable. Media: ESPN (ESPN+) deal. Ivy Madness basketball tournament rotates among campuses. Not a realignment target or source in the game except as a 'prestige' scheduling partner.

name: Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference

football.notes: Champion plays the SWAC champion in the Celebration Bowl (Atlanta) instead of entering the FCS playoffs.

notes: HBCU conference. Lost Florida A&M and Bethune-Cookman (SWAC, 2021), NC A&T (Big South 2021, then CAA), Hampton (2018), Savannah State (D-II, 2019). Six football members is the minimum for a viable FCS league — the most at-risk FCS football league numerically. Media: ESPN partnership; Celebration Bowl on ABC.

name: Missouri Valley Football Conference

commissioner.note: Long-time commissioner of the Gateway/MVFC and Pioneer Football League; reported to be at/near retirement — verify whether a successor took over in 2024-26. Compiled without live web verification (session search budget exhausted, web fetch blocked); verify before relying on it.

notes: Football-only league (members' other sports are in MVC, Summit, Horizon). Strongest FCS conference of the 2010s-2020s (NDSU 9 titles 2011-2021 + 2024; SDSU 2022-23). Losing NDSU and Missouri State makes it the main source of the next FBS move-ups (South Dakota State, UND, UNI). Shares St. Louis offices with the Missouri Valley Conference and Pioneer Football League.

name: Northeast Conference

recentChanges.change: left Division I for Division III
recentChanges.notes: Announced 2025 citing post-House financial model; low confidence on exact effective year.

notes: Lowest-resourced FCS league in the Northeast; survives by recruiting D-II up-movers (Stonehill, Le Moyne, Mercyhurst, New Haven). Lost Saint Francis (D-III), Merrimack and Sacred Heart (MAAC). Football depends on affiliates Duquesne and Robert Morris — at risk if either leaves. FDU's 2023 upset of Purdue is the league's signature moment.

name: Big South–OVC Football Association

commissioner.name: Beth DeBauche
commissioner.note: Football association jointly administered by the OVC (Beth DeBauche) and Big South (Sherika Montgomery) offices; no separate commissioner. 'since' = association start.

recentChanges.notes: Kennesaw was Big South football before the association formed.

notes: Formed because neither the Big South (2 football schools) nor the OVC (7) could sustain a full FCS league alone after losses to FBS (Liberty, Kennesaw, Jacksonville State, EKU/Austin Peay to ASUN). Single automatic bid. Fragile by construction: any 3-4 departures break it.

name: Patriot League

football.format: 9-team round robin if Richmond/W&M joined (7 teams/6 games otherwise)

notes: Founded as the Colonial League (football) in 1986; full athletic scholarships in football only since 2013. Academic-index league; Army and Navy are full members whose football plays FBS in the American. Stable, conservative, low-cost; attractive to academically selective CAA schools. Media: CBS Sports Network/ESPN+ (low confidence).

name: Pioneer Football League

commissioner.name: Patty Viverito
commissioner.note: PFL commissioner since founding (administered from the MVFC/MVC offices); verify whether still in office.

football.format: 11 teams, 8-game partial round robin; non-scholarship football

notes: Football-only, non-scholarship league whose members' other sports are in the Big East, A-10, MVC, MAAC, OVC, Big South, WCC, Summit, ASUN. First played 1993; auto bid since 2013. Coast-to-coast travel is a cost problem; St. Thomas dominance since 2022. Very low budgets — exits would be to D-III/dropping football rather than moving up.

name: Southern Conference

commissioner.name: Michael Cragg
commissioner.note: Believed to have succeeded Jim Schaus (2020-23); verify. Compiled without live web verification (session search budget exhausted, web fetch blocked); verify before relying on it.

notes: Fourth-oldest conference; historically the parent of the ACC and SEC. Lost Appalachian State and Georgia Southern (Sun Belt/FBS, 2014), Elon (CAA), Davidson and College of Charleston; rebuilt with ETSU, Mercer and VMI (2014). Chattanooga is the most plausible FBS mover. Media: ESPN+ (low confidence).

name: Southland Conference

recentChanges.notes: Low confidence on exact all-sports entry year.

name: Southwestern Athletic Conference

football.format: Two 6-team divisions (East/West) with SWAC Championship Game
football.notes: Champion plays MEAC champion in the Celebration Bowl; classics (Bayou Classic, Magic City Classic, State Fair Classic, Florida Classic) drive revenue.

notes: Largest HBCU conference; leads FCS in attendance via neutral-site classics and Jackson State. Deion Sanders era (2020-22) raised national profile. Added FAMU and Bethune-Cookman in 2021. Stable membership; financial fragility at some members (MVSU, UAPB). Media: ESPN deal; HBCU GO.

name: United Athletic Conference

commissioner.name: Rich Hilton
commissioner.note: UAC is the ASUN-WAC football partnership, administered through the WAC/ASUN offices; commissioner identity unverified (see WAC record).

Spans Georgia to Utah. Low confidence: reports that the WAC would rebrand as the UAC for all sports — verify. Tarleton and Abilene Christian are the most FBS-ambitious members.

name: America East Conference

commissioner.name: Amy Huchthausen
commissioner.note: Former NCAA championships staffer. Tenure not re-verified for 2024-26.

notes: Founded as ECAC North. Lost Hartford (dropped to D-III, 2023) and Stony Brook (CAA, 2022); added Bryant (2022). Football-playing members (Albany, Bryant, Maine, UNH) play CAA Football. One-bid basketball league; Vermont is the anchor. Media: ESPN+.

name: ASUN Conference
notes: Formerly Trans America Athletic Conference / Atlantic Sun. Has served as the launch pad for FBS move-ups (Jacksonville State 2023, Kennesaw State 2024, Liberty earlier via Big South). Football via the UAC (Austin Peay, UCA, EKU, UNA, UWG) and Pioneer (Stetson). Media: ESPN+.

name: Atlantic 10 Conference

mbbTournament.notes: Rotated between Barclays Center (Brooklyn) and Capital One Arena (DC) in recent years — low confidence.

notes: Best non-football basketball league after the Big East/WCC tier; multi-bid in good years (Dayton, VCU, Saint Louis, Loyola Chicago). No football sponsorship: Davidson/Dayton (Pioneer), Duquesne (NEC), Fordham/Richmond (Patriot), Rhode Island (CAA). Media: CBS Sports, ESPN, USA Network/NBCU package through ~2027-28 (low confidence).

name: Big East Conference

members2026.notes: Football: UConn FBS independent; Villanova CAA Football (FCS); Georgetown Patriot League (FCS); Butler Pioneer (FCS). The league also has single-sport affiliates in sports such as field hockey and lacrosse (not enumerated).

governance.notes: Catholic-7 schools bought the Big East name and MSG tournament rights in the 2013 split; the football-playing charter became the American (big-east-2010 lineage).

mediaDeal.summary: FOX Sports has been lead partner since the 2013 re-formation (original 12-year deal, ~$500M). In 2023 the league renewed for six years through 2030-31 with FOX as primary rightsholder and added NBCUniversal (NBC/Peacock) — and reportedly TNT Sports — as secondary partners. Total annual value not verified.

notes: Basketball-first power league (UConn 2023 & 2024 national champions; Villanova 2016/2018). Highest-revenue non-FBS conference; regularly multi-bid. Founded 1979; the current legal entity dates to 2013. Stable; UConn football independence and potential P4 courtship of UConn/others are the main storylines.

name: Big South Conference
notes: Lost Liberty (2018), Coastal Carolina (2016), Campbell (CAA 2023), Hampton & NC A&T (2021-22 then CAA), Kennesaw (football). Football via the Big South-OVC association (Charleston Southern, Gardner-Webb) and Pioneer (Presbyterian). High Point's private investment is the league's growth story. Media: ESPN+.

name: Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference

notes: Northeast private-school basketball league (Saint Peter's 2022 Elite Eight). Sponsored football until 2007; today Marist plays Pioneer football and Merrimack/Sacred Heart play as FCS independents — a natural seed for a new Northeast football league. Media: ESPN+.

name: Missouri Valley Conference

commissioner.name: Jeff Jackson

name: Ohio Valley Conference
notes: Lost Jacksonville State & Eastern Kentucky (ASUN 2021), Austin Peay, Belmont, Murray State (2022); rebuilt with Lindenwood, Southern Indiana, Little Rock (2022) and Western Illinois (2023). Football via the Big South-OVC association (7 members); Morehead State plays Pioneer. Tennessee State's institutional crisis is a risk. Media: ESPN+.
